checkpoints.description: [1/4] Stage 1 plan: sandboxed coding harness shape, ladder R0-R3, budgets, kill switch, transcript replay, verify gates

impact_assessment.why: Need agents that edit, run, observe, retry sandboxed to green with logged replayable runs
impact_assessment.benefits: Falsifiable ladder plus escape and replay gates prove containment and autonomy before any long run
impact_assessment.risks: contract: transcript replay and verdict schema drift; dependency: stdlib-only plus pytest oracle; concurrency: single-run jail, no parallel agents yet; state: scratch workspace plus JSONL log must survive kill
impact_assessment.mitigation: Freeze Action/Observation/verdict schema in ADR-001; allow-list exec plus jail plus escape test; budget and STOP checked before each step; action-before-exec fsync plus replay verify

[1/2] UI contract for the CLI surface: demo/inventory proofs AI can run while coding

impact_assessment.why: AI coding the harness needs a bounded, proof-checked UI surface
impact_assessment.benefits: Fast and snapshot proofs verify the CLI on every UI change
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ui.json schema and proof commands; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: ui-task file must not linger open
impact_assessment.mitigation: Manual zero-dependency contract; begin, verify, then abort to restore clean baseline

impact_assessment.why: Harness runs but its hardness is unproven: ceilings, mid-exec kill and transcript provenance need verification
impact_assessment.benefits: Ordered gap list with runtime evidence; fixes land sandbox-first without breaking green rungs
impact_assessment.risks: contract: transcript format versioning if fields added; dependency: stdlib only, Windows Popen semantics; concurrency: kill polling must stay single-threaded and simple; state: probe temps kept outside repo, tree restored clean
impact_assessment.mitigation: Probes ran on TEMP scratch only; transcripts restored; no repo writes in audit; fixes ordered sandbox, observability, rungs
